title: Too Cute!
description:
Fuzzy Polar Puppies
Nanook, a shy Chinook, is the only boy in a litter of four and is training to be a sled dog; Rocky the Labradoodle and his brother Stanley grow up poolside.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E03 — Bacon and Tomato's Big Adventure
The staff becomes concerned when Jupiter, the rescued sea lion, is not himself; the Ocean Voyager exhibit awaits its new residents, black-blotched fantail stingray siblings Bacon and Tomato; Shelley the shy box turtle makes friends.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E02 — Sea Otter Summer Camp
The team is determined to have Gibson the sea otter pup discover his independence as he separates from his pal, Mara; the African penguins head off-site for spring-cleaning; Thor the moray eel proves he's the ultimate escape artist.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E04 — Coral Super Bowl
The staff becomes concerned when beloved African penguin Zola falls mysteriously ill; the aquarium witnesses the annual spawning of an endangered coral species; Maggie the false map turtle has a date with the dentist.

title: Tanked
description:
S04 E06 — A Guiding Light to Fitness
Wayde and Brett design a multipurpose tank for a fitness mogul; an Alabama casino requests a tank with a scaled replica of a historical lighthouse.

title: Tanked
description:
S04 E08 — Fermenting Donuts
Wayde and Brett transport a fully operational beer fermenter, then head south to create a doughnut-shaped tank.

title: Tanked
description:

Redneck designs a RV aquarium; the team builds a large indoor tank that holds both alligators and sharks.

title: Tanked
description:

Wayde and Brett create a temporary tank for basketball star Dwyane Wade; a North Carolina restaurant requests a burger- and sushi-filled aquarium.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:

Adventure-themed treehouse with suspension bridges, rock-climbing wall and hidden passages is built in the Pocono Mountains.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E07 — Record High Recording Studio
Pete builds a high-tech recording studio oasis up in the trees that perfectly blends into the heart of the outdoors. CeeLo Green soon arrives to lay down a brand-new track upon completion.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E05 — Sky High Redwood Retreat
The team attempts to construct a chic but Bohemian tri-level, 60-foot-high treehouse in three giant redwoods for an arborist in Humboldt County, Calif.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E03 — Black Bear Bungalow
Pete creates his first-ever midcentury decagon when he builds a tree house to observe bears in Farmington, Pa. -- complete with walls of glass windows and a "bear-cam" tracking system.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E06 — Levitating Lighthouse
A couple dreams of having a treehouse atop a lighthouse in Washington, and Pete finds the property's steep grade challenging.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E01 — Santa's Workshop
Pete has one week to build a Christmas-treehouse wonderland in the desert outside Jamul, Calif., for a family who celebrates Christmas 365 days a year; members of the Fraternal Order of Real Bearded Santas lend a helping hand.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S02 E04 — Wild Butterfly Escape
Pete builds a butterfly-themed treehouse that includes six trees in Independence, Ohio, for a hope center that wanted a therapeutic space within the trees.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:

Pete builds a 600-square foot Western-style man-cave tree house that includes a cigar humidor, a meat smoker, and a flat-screen TV, for a father of three daughters in Texas.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:

Pete uses hand-hewn rustic cedar to build an African-inspired circular hut treehouse complete with aerial walkway, spiral staircase and thatched roof.

description:
S05 E08 — Mississippi Mayhem
The boys look back at their fondest and most dangerous mishaps in Mississippi including the time they helped the Gulf Coast Gator Ranch capture over 200 gators, or the first gator they caught, named Petsy.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S06 E01 — Stretched Too Thin
As the calls keep coming in, everyone has been stretched thin since Jimmy quit; Paul comes to the begrudging realization that it's time to replace him.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E02 — One Hundred Lions
In the heart of Mozambique's Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists has overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times; following the reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, the population has grown to over 100 today.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E10 — Crow Crime Scene
A look at how spiders covered a town in webs overnight and why a lake in South America is the lightning capital of the world.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E08 — A Warthog Named Peaches
Peaches, a 2-month-old warthog, charms his keepers while training to become an animal ambassador; a nervous one-horned rhino adjusts to her new exhibit; Willow, a red panda, shows signs of being pregnant.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E14 — Snow Monkey Social
A new bison calf has a hard time keeping up with his mom; the bird department prepares a group of Von der Decken hornbill chicks for their move to the Minnesota Zoo; keepers at the Central Park Zoo hope the female snow monkeys accept a new male.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E11 — Giraffe in the City
A giraffe named Mashengo journeys from the Indiana Zoo to his new home in the Bronx; keepers hand-raise endangered ducklings and release them at the Central Park Children's Zoo; love is in the air for a pair of cloud rats.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E07 — The Kings of Queens
A trio of new penguin chicks are introduced to the pool for their first swim; family dynamics change when the mandrill monkey troop welcomes a new baby; a pair of king vultures are prepped for their big debut at the Queens Zoo.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E06 — Baby Bunnies, Big World
Crate training Nikita the Amur tiger in preparation for her move to Washington, D.C., proves challenging; an endangered Chinese alligator shows signs of being pregnant; staff prepare to release rare New England cottontail rabbits into the wild.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E12 — Taming of the Shrew
Cardiologists try to determine why the geladas are experiencing a life-threatening heart condition; Nile crocodiles are shifted off exhibit for a maintenance project; the elephant shrews are breeding.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E02 — Rise to the Challenge
Dr. Jeff attempts to diagnose a dog's devastating mystery illness; vet tech Hector's daughter is tasked with caring for a mother dog and her seven pups; Dr. Baier volunteers to help find new homes for rescued rabbits.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E07 — New Body for Lolly
Dr. Jeff preps a Shiba Inu for surgery after she's struck by a car; Dr. Baier performs his first-ever wild goose operation; an obese Yorkshire terrier struggling to walk begins a strict weight-loss plan.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E09 — Healing Farm
Dr. Jeff tackles challenging surgeries on a pit bull with a broken leg and a feisty kitten's torn lower lip; Dr. Amy treats a dog that's acting sickly after a camping trip; Dr. Don handles a bladder stone removal on vet tech Christine's family pet.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E04 — Making a Splash
Dr. Jeff makes a shocking discovery when a rescued street pup named Kova comes in with a severely injured leg; little Fonda needs to find a forever home after being thrown from a car; Dr. Jeff builds his beloved dog, Fred, his very own swimming pool.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E05 — Hero Dog
Dr. Jeff comes to the rescue of an injured raccoon found in an illegal trap; Dr. Jeff is thrown by a medical mystery when Gordo the chihuahua comes in with a fever; Bob the black lab suffers a deep wound after protecting his owner.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E08 — Old Dog, New Hope
Dr. Jeff and his team lend a hand at National Mill Dog Rescue and are eager to find Ginger the Pomeranian a forever home; a dog that loves to swallow household objects must undergo emergency surgery; Jimmy the gecko gives Dr. Baier a surprise.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S08 E03 — Little Puppy, Big Heart
Khaleesi, the golden retriever pup undergoes a life-saving procedure; vet tech Blaire faces heartbreak over her beloved senior dog, Zula; during the global pandemic, Dr. Jeff and Hector ensure pets from an elderly community receive proper care.

title: Dr. Dee: Alaska Vet
description:
S02 E10 — 40 Snakes and Counting
Dr. Dee performs surgery on a dog for three hours straight to save its life; diagnosis is changed on a dog with seizures; Dr. Dee and Ken trek to Yakutat, Alaska where they haven't seen a veterinarian in two years.

title: Dr. Dee: Alaska Vet
description:
S02 E11 — Battling FIV

title: Gator Boys
description:
S06 E02 — A Twist of Fate
The Gator Boys are convinced now more than ever, after some sub-par volunteers and dangerous gators, that they really need to get Jimmy back; Ashley twists her ankle while trying to help Paul, turning a gator capture into a deadly situation.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S06 E04 — The Legend of Moby Dick
With gator hunting season on the horizon, the Gator Boys race against time in Mississippi to find and rescue the gigantic gator known as Moby Dick, before the hunters catch a massive prize.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E01 — Monster Crabber
Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E03 — Mr. Bad Guy
In southern Louisiana, Lt. David Nunez and Sgt. Austin Arteaga investigate a group of bird hunters on opening day of teal season; a repeated offender is busted for taking immature crabs; a late-night deer decoy leads to a hunter in handcuffs.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E02 — Road Killer
In Jackson Parish, a reckless hunter is investigated for shooting down a highway; agents stake out a man suspected of two illegal deer kills; duck hunters are confronted for harassment; a crowded boat parade ends with citations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E05 — Blind Rage
As a storm rolls in over St. Tammany Parish, Cpl. Blaine Wagner and Cpl. Rick Clark assist in a search-and-rescue mission for a missing fisherman; agents confront a repeat offender for harassing hunters, and a felon is caught with an illegal firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E06 — Deer in the Headlights
In Ouachita Parish, a trespassing investigation leads to a dicey encounter and multiple seizures of deer; agents confront a group of duck hunters who are spotted killing non-game birds; health code violations are found during a routine oyster patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E04 — Spy in the Sky
While using the LDWF's spy in the sky drone, agents track down a boat captain breaking the law in Plaquemines Parish; a family of shrimpers is investigated for pulling oversized nets; two feuding fishermen are suspected of being under the influence.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E07 — In the Eye of Hurricane Ida
As Hurricane Ida makes landfall, wildlife agents deploy to help the people of Louisiana; an injured woman is trapped in a flooded hotel; elderly neighbors await rescue in punishing conditions; lifesaving supplies must be delivered to those in need.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E08 — Lights, Camera, Elk-tion
Wardens have their skills put to the test as they search for a bear that attempts to enter houses for food; they also investigate people using illegal camera set ups to lure in elk to hunt.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E01 — Seeley Lake Lies
Wardens on Seeley Lake enforce boating licenses and prepare for the Yellowstone boat float; they keep rafts steady and uncover illegal fishing, ensuring safety and lawfulness amidst the fun.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E07 — Arresting Behavior
A look at the lives of Montana conservation officers who defend public lands, handle anti-poaching sting operations and more.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E09 — Trespassers Beware
The Wardens combat a string of trespassing instances around this time.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E10 — Caught in the Act
Discovering the lives of conservation officers of Montana defending public lands, handling anti-poaching sting operations and more.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E02 — Salmon Snaggers
After a tip-off, wardens investigate poaching in dense forests and rugged terrains; other wardens monitor salmon snagging, ensuring fair play and dodging grizzly bears; tensions rise as enforcement meets nature's challenges.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E11 — Valley Poaching Assault
Wardens must be cautious as they release a trapped black bear back into the wild; they pull together all their resources to stop illegal hunting in the valley.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E03 — Felonies and Fines
Wardens uncover a crime scene while others patrol summer crowds, issuing fines for littering and DUI; amidst the chaos, Captain Jeff Darrah retires after 26 years, leaving a legacy of dedication and bravery.
